language_origin.basis: New English synthesis of verified historical traces and preserved method versions; no human review claimed.

retrieval_summary: Compare bounded continuation against structural hypotheses while preserving identities, budgets and fair optimization opportunities.
trigger: Compare bounded continuation against structural hypotheses while preserving identities, budgets and fair optimization opportunities.
procedure: A terminated local search, solver stagnation and structural infeasibility are distinct conclusions. Only an appropriate verified exclusion can support a stronger claim.
Read residuals and distinguish physical input bounds, coefficient bounds, trust regions and model validity. An active algorithmic bound is not automatically a physical limitation.

M1 continued a failing condition before recording a structural hypothesis. M2 used same-candidate control continuation near a strict threshold. M3 borrowed a hypothesis but reoptimized for its own draft task.

After a structure change, adapt control and independently recheck every required condition. Extra optimization opportunities confound claims of structural superiority; preserve authorization and failure costs.

bindings.physics: Check task-local model, load, constraints and validity before transfer

applicability: Neither additional budget nor a plausible hypothesis guarantees a pass. Historical STOP does not authorize autonomous continuation.
escalation: Obtain current scoped evidence and separate action authorization; retain original evaluator and budgets.

evidence.source_scope: Preserved previous method version; follow its original source chain.
